init_decs: A rectangular two-section LED panel is mounted on a plain wall. No people or moving objects appear. Fixed front-facing camera with stable exposure. Both sections remain fixed. Initially, the left half glows red and the right half glows blue.
events_decs: The left half changes from red to green while the right half remains blue.
The right half changes from blue to yellow while the left half remains green.
Both halves change together to a uniform white.

init_decs: Two identical smart bulbs are mounted side by side against a plain indoor background. No people or moving objects appear. Fixed camera with stable exposure and framing. Both bulbs remain stationary. Initially, the left bulb glows red and the right bulb glows blue.
events_decs: The left bulb changes from red to green while the right bulb remains blue.
The right bulb changes from blue to yellow while the left bulb remains green.
Both bulbs change together to white.

init_decs: A plain chessboard is viewed from directly above. No hands, people, or other pieces are present. One black chess piece is stationary on a square near the lower-left area.
events_decs: The chess piece slides in a straight line to a square near the centre of the board.
The same piece slides from the centre to a square near the upper-right area.

init_decs: An empty airport-style corridor is shown from a fixed side camera. No people or other moving objects appear. A single upright wheeled suitcase is stationary near the left side.
events_decs: The suitcase rolls steadily from left to right along the corridor.
The suitcase rolls back from right to left and stops near its starting area.

init_decs: A simple outdoor mailbox is shown from a fixed side camera. No people, vehicles, or moving objects appear. Stable daylight and background. Initially, the mailbox door is closed and its side flag is lowered.
events_decs: The mailbox side flag rises to the upright position while the door remains closed.
The mailbox door opens while the flag remains upright.
The mailbox door closes and the flag lowers back to its initial position.

init_decs: A plain studio floor with one compact camera tripod centred in frame. No people or other moving objects appear. Fixed camera shows the full tripod. Initially, all three tripod legs are folded together.
events_decs: The tripod legs spread outward until the tripod is fully opened and stable.
The tripod legs fold back together until the tripod is compact again.

init_decs: A clean gym-style bench is shown from a fixed camera. No people or objects are visible. Stable indoor lighting. Initially, the bench is empty.
events_decs: A transparent water bottle appears upright on the bench.
The water bottle disappears, leaving the bench empty again.

init_decs: A simple empty warehouse-style floor area is shown from a fixed camera. No people, vehicles, or objects are visible. Stable lighting and framing. Initially, the floor area is empty.
events_decs: A small sealed cardboard box appears near the centre of the floor.
A second sealed cardboard box appears beside the first box.
The first box disappears while the second box remains visible.

init_decs: A stationary rectangular box sits on a level tabletop. No people or moving objects appear. Initially, the camera is level and front-facing with the horizon and table edge horizontal.
events_decs: The camera view gradually tilts clockwise by a noticeable angle while the box remains stationary.
The camera view gradually returns to the original level orientation.

init_decs: A stationary floor lamp stands against a plain wall. No people or moving objects appear. Initially, the camera uses a normal wide horizontal composition with the full lamp visible and natural realistic appearance.
events_decs: The framing changes to a tighter portrait-like crop centred on the lamp while the lamp itself remains stationary.
The framing returns to the original wider horizontal composition.
